intro.label: New Year at Villa Madau · 31 December 2026 – 1 January 2027
intro.title: A different
intro.p1: This year, treat yourselves to a different New Year’s Eve: a night in the heart of Pula, the pleasure of a dinner chosen freely and a first of January lived at your own pace.
intro.p2: Villa Madau Boutique Hotel welcomes you to its comfortable rooms, a few steps from Federico’s restaurant. Celebrate on the evening of 31 December and, after the toast, enjoy not having to get back in the car to drive home.
intro.p3: We are in the historic centre of Pula, in southern Sardinia, about 40 km from Cagliari: the ideal place for New Year’s Eve in Sardinia away from the crowds, between the town’s streets and the winter sea.
intro.imageAlt: Double room at Villa Madau in warm evening light, historic centre of Pula

cena.label: The evening of 31 December
cena.title: A special dinner,
cena.p1: On New Year’s Eve, Federico’s offers its à la carte menu, enriched with special dishes created for the occasion. No fixed-menu gala dinner: everyone chooses freely what to eat, according to their tastes and wishes.
cena.p2: Dinner is optional, not included in the price of the stay and paid separately according to what you order. Booking a table is recommended.
cena.imageAlt: Evening in Pula’s historic centre, street lamp and rooftops at sunset

primoGennaio.label: 1 January
primoGennaio.title: The first of January?
primoGennaio.p1: Forget the alarm clock. At Villa Madau the new year begins with a breakfast to enjoy slowly, and the pleasure of spending the morning however you like: relaxing, strolling through the streets of Pula, heading to Nora or to the sea at Chia.
primoGennaio.p2: And for those who would like to linger at the table, Federico’s will also be open for lunch, with a special discount for hotel guests.
primoGennaio.imageAlt: Breakfast at Villa Madau: croissants, fresh fruit and coffee

anticipo.label: Early booking
anticipo.title: Book early,
anticipo.p1: Book by 15 December and late check-out until 4 pm on the first of January is included, for the rooms reserved for this offer. A morning — and much of the afternoon — with no clock.

items.q: Is the New Year’s Eve dinner included?
items.a: No. The stay includes one night in a double room and breakfast on 1 January. Dinner on 31 December at Federico’s is optional, à la carte and paid separately according to what you order: there is no set menu.

items.q: How does New Year’s Eve dinner at Federico’s work?
items.a: On the evening of 31 December, Federico’s offers its à la carte menu, enriched with special dishes created for the occasion. Everyone chooses freely what to order. Booking a table is recommended.

items.q: How much does New Year’s Eve at Villa Madau cost?
items.a: €209 per couple for one night in a double room with breakfast on 1 January. Dinner is excluded and optional.

items.q: Until what time can we keep the room on 1 January?
items.a: For bookings made by 15 December, late check-out until 4 pm is included, limited to the rooms reserved for this offer.

items.q: What can you do in Pula on 1 January?
items.a: Stroll through the historic centre, or head to Nora and the little church of Sant’Efisio by the sea, the dunes of Chia or the ancient Roman road Nora–Bithia. For museums and archaeological sites, check holiday opening hours in advance.

items.q: How far is Pula from Cagliari?
items.a: About 40 km, both from Cagliari city centre and from Cagliari Elmas airport. Villa Madau is on Via Nora, in the historic centre of Pula.
